balls.text: full toss hit hard and high over the midwicket fence for maximum, a wonderful strike that.
hit hard down the ground to long off, Hodge wanted the second run but van Wyk turns it down.
short ball and pulled well by Hodge this time through square leg to the fence. Hodge is playing wonderfully well.
another full delivery and a superb shot from Hodge once again, driven hard along the ground past the bowler and bisects the field in the deep.
lovely shot from Hodge, it was fuller and wide outside the off stump, goes after it and hits it over extra cover for a boundary.
full delivery, mistimes down the ground to long on, coming back for the second run.
full toss hit to midwicket.
pulled away nicely behind square leg for a boundary.
down the track and takes it on the full and miscues it high in the air to midwicket, the ball falls in no mans land.
full toss wide outside the off stump, played out to the sweeper and that brings up Hodge's 50!
short delivery and slower from Abdulla, off the pad they go through for a leg bye.
full toss hit down the ground to wide long on and Malik does well to stop it.
full toss slammed away past backward point to the fence. Hodge is on 49.
short and slower from Pathan, van Wyk too early into the shot, takes it on the body, it has hurt him.
looking for the big booming drive through the off side, mistimes to cover.
full toss driven to deep mid-off.
once again driven along the ground to the sweeper.
fuller and wide outside the off stump, driven along the ground to the sweeper.
full delivery driven down the ground to long off for a single.
slower delivery and van Wyk waits for it and plays it fine down to the fence.
full delivery hit hard along the ground to extra cover.
plays square of the wicket on the off side straight to the fielder.
opens the face off the bat and plays it down to third man, Chawla picks up the ball and slips, has hurt his ankle, the batsmen take two.
down the track and drives down the ground to long on.

tossed up delivery and Ganguly looking to swing it high and over the fence, miscues it high in the air and on the track, both Sangakkara and Chawla go for the catch, but it is Sangakkara who takes the catch.
cut along the ground to the sweeper, Hodge calls Ganguly for the second run.
sweeps and the ball takes the pad down to fine leg, the umpire signals a wide.
looking to paddle it fine, the ball takes the pad to third man.
lovely shot from Ganguly, comes down the track and down on his knee and swings it high and over the square leg fence for maximum.
looking to pull, mistimes through the vacant midwicket.
opens the face off the bat and plays to short third man to pick up a single.
that goes a long way into the stands at long on. Hodge hits it hard and in the air over the fence for maximum, wonderful strike.
short ball right into the rib cage and Gangly jumps up and plays to the onside for a single.
fuller delivery outside the off stump and Ganguly opens the face off the bat and plays down very fine of third man.
cut away down to third man for a single. Boundaries yet to flow from the bat.
fuller delivery worked forward of square leg to the deep.
plays through point to the deep for a single.
cuts it hard to cover but straight to the fielder.
moves forward and looks to play down the ground, gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball trickles to the off side.
uses his feet and pushes to mid-on.
pushes it quicker and fuller outside the off stump, driven along the ground to the sweeper.
moves back and pushes to extra cover.
tossed up outside the off stump, down the track and drives to long on.
slower and too short from Malik, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket.
pushes back down the track and a good stop by Malik on his follow-through.
short ball angled across, runs it down to third man.
moves back and punches through the off side to cover for a single.
opens the face off the bat and runs it down to third man.
good ball on the stumps and Ganguly is forced to play it back down the track.
again put away, another short delivery and Hodge rocks onto the back foot and pulls well to the midwicket fence, the ball was bit closer to the fielder this time but he could not stop it.
a poor delivery from Yuvraj, a long hop and well put away by Hodge, pulls well along the ground to midwicket fence.
down the track and looks to defend, off the pad to the off side.
lovely shot from Ganguly, plays it late down to third man.
waits for the turn and works it to midwicket for a single.
moves forward and plays with an open face off the bat to backward point.
moves back and defends to the off side.
wonderful use of the feet from Hodge, comes down the track and hits it hard over the bowler to the fence.
an appeal for lbw as the ball spins and strikes the pad, turned down as the ball pitched outside the leg stump.
a long hop and McCullum fails once again, pulls straight down the throat of deep backward square leg.
defends on the front foot to extra cover.
works it through the vacant onside, good running from McCullum and Hodge to pick up the second run.
plays behind point and goes for a tight single.
pushes down the ground to mid-off.
sweeps well this time in the air and on the bounce to deep backward square leg.
a touch short and McCullum goes for the pull, mistimes to midwicket, good running, picks up couple of runs.
sweeps and misses, takes it on the body.
cut hard behind point and a misfield allows the boundary, McCullum's first boundary of the match.
good ball to finish the over, pushes it quickly and Hodge plays it back to Chawla.
lovely shot from Hodge, comes down the track and hits well in the air through midwicket to the fence.
quicker delivery pushed to the vacant onside for a single.
this time Hodge down the wicket and drives down the ground to long off.
down the wicket and hits down the ground in the air and on the bounce to Powar.
tossed up outside the leg stump, off the pad to short fine leg.
cuts hard to deep point to pick up a single and retains the strike for the next over.
good delivery outside the off stump, McCullum gets beaten as he plays forward.
looking for the big shot, chips it in the air to deep square leg for a single.
full delivery worked along the ground straight to the fielder at midwicket.
short and wide outside the off stump, Hodge does well, cuts behind point past the fielder and the ball goes to the fence, a boundary after a long time.
fuller delivery played back down the track and fielded by the bowler on his follow-through.
good ball keeping it full in the block-hole, played back to the bowler.
moves forward and works through the vacant midwicket.
plays again to short third man, this time Hodge calls McCullum through for a single.
again no run, plays towards short third man.
moves back and plays to cover, the fielder quickly to his right to field the ball.
short ball and down the leg side and gets away with it as McCullum fails to put it away.
short ball pulled around to deep midwicket, good running from Hodge comes back for the second run.
down the track and looks to go big, misses it completely and through to the keeper.
pushed back down the track to the bowler.
short ball and Hodge pulls along the g round through midwicket for couple of runs.
plays it down to third man for a single.
plays towards gully, Hodge comes for the run, sent back and the throw from Katich misses the stumps, a run out chance missed.
fuller and slower from Abdulla, defends to the off side.
good ball angled across, Hodge watches it closely and lets it go.
Abdulla strikes, it was in the slot once again and Gayle drives hard but this time he picks out Yuvraj at mid-on.
gets in line and defends to cover.
take that! Powerful shot from Gayle, full and in the slot and Gayle powers it in the air past mid-off to the fence.
on the middle and leg and Gayle flicks it away behind square leg to the fence.
full toss and still not put away, played to cover straight to the fielder.
full and too wide outside the off stump, McCullum looks to play it, that was too wide.
short delivery and McCullum still not finding his form, defends square of the wicket on the off side.
back of a length delivery angled across, left alone.
fuller delivery pushed to cover, good diving stop there.
good comeback from Pathan, right in the block-hole, Gayle digs it out past the bowler for a single.
first boundary of the innings from Gayle's blade. It was on the middle and leg and Gayle clips it in the air to long leg fence.
good ball swinging in and on target, McCullum is forced to defend down the track.
fuller on the legs and Gayle pushes to the right of mid-on for a single.
width outside the off stump, Gayle goes after it and gets beaten.
full and straight and in the slot and Gayle hammers it down to mid-on.
good length delivery swinging away outside the off stump, left alone through to the keeper.
full on the legs and McCullum plays it behind square leg.
opens the face off the bat and runs it down to third man for couple of runs.
good length delivery on target and Gayle blocks it.
fuller and swinging away, it was right in the block-hole and Gayle digs it out to the off side.
left alone outside the off stump.
good length delivery swinging away outside the off stump, Gayle lets it go through to the keeper.
back of a length delivery outside the off stump, lets it go.
gets an outside edge as he plays forward, down to third man for a single.
worked to the vacant midwicket for a single.
pushed to the onside.
too wide outside the off stump.
flight and turn, takes it on the pad as he played forward.
moves forward and plays to short third man.
tossed up wide and McCullum cuts down to third man to pick up couple of runs and gets the Knight Riders off to a start.
full delivery and Pathan gets it through the infield on the onside for the winning run and Kings XI Punjab win.
full delivery driven hard along the ground to the sweeper.
good delivery from Agarkar, a low full toss pushed back down the track.
outside edge and down to third man, Ganguly puts in a dive but cannot stop it, goes to the fence.
good short delivery from Agarkar, plays and misses and through to the keeper. Jayawardene was looking for the full delivery.
low full toss, Pathan mistimes to the onside and Saha fails to field the ball cleanly.
full toss hit straight to Ganguly at midwicket and shy at the stumps misses.
short ball pulled nicely past the midwicket, all along the ground to the fence.
full toss driven to the sweeper.
full toss outside the off stump, just misses the stump, plays and misses, through to van Wyk.
lovely shot from Jayawardene, the mid-off was in and he lofts it over the fielder to the fence, that reduces the pressure.
slower delivery and Pathan sweeps it down to fine leg for a single.
another full toss and Pathan plays it out to the sweeper on the off side.
low full toss and Pathan does well to get it away, gets it down to fine leg fence.
full delivery squeezed out to deep point for a single.
run out missed, played straight to Gayle at backward point, the throw misses the stumps.
low full toss driven hard to extra cover, straight to McCullum.
good ball in the block-hole, squeezed out to the off side.
comes forward and pushes to cover for a single.
full toss driven down the ground to long off.
down the track and takes it on the full and drives to long on.
quicker delivery cut to short third man, good diving stop.
swept well to fine leg fence.
loud appeal for lbw turned down, that was close, not given by the umpire.
delicately done by Jayawarden to short fine leg, well fielded.
works it to square leg for a single.
cuts along the ground to backward point.
sweeps and misses, off the pad behind the wicket.
pushes on the front foot to cover.
works it through midwicket for a single.
pushes on the front foot square of the wicket on the off side to the deep.
steers it down to slip and well fielded by Gayle.
lovely shot from Jayawardene, short ball outside the off stump and he cuts well in the air behind point and to the fence.
pushes to mid-off for a single.
low full toss driven to mid-on.
Yuvraj down the track and hits well in the air but picks out the fielder at deep point, Hodge takes the catch.
comes forward and pushes to mid-on, McCullum is quickly in to prevent the single.
works it through the vacant midwicket for a single.
driven down the ground to long off.
worked to midwicket for a single.
cut in the air and bisects the field behind the wicket, over backward point to the fence.
driven to extra cover and the throw comes into the bowler and umpire Benson ducks for cover, falls on the ground.
pushes down the ground to mid-on.
another ball down the leg side and van Wyk does well with his pads to stop it.
good ball right in the block-hole, Yuvraj is forced to push back down the track.
punches off the back foot to mid-on.
played back to the bowler.
worked to square leg, a misfield allows the second run.
down the leg side, sweeps and misses.
cut through point to the deep and Saha runs around to field the ball.
pushes to midwicket for a single, throw at the stumps, misses. run out chance missed by McCullum.
was looking to wind up was Yuvraj, drives it down the ground to long on.
moves foward and pushes down the ground to long off.
full toss and Jayawardene puts it away nicely past the short fine leg and no stopping that.
tossed up bit fuller outside the off stump, driven down the ground to long off.
works it behind square leg to pick up a single.
works it forward of square leg for a single.
cuts hard behind point but cannot beat the field.
pushes square of the wicket on the off side for an easy single.
cuts along the ground to the sweeper.
turns it around to square leg to pick up a single.
played behind square leg.
cut away nicely to deep backward point for couple of runs.
sweeps from outside the off stump and misses, takes it on his pad.
comes forward and defends on the track.
down the leg side, a wide.
works it nicely through square leg to get off the mark.
full toss and Katich hits well in the air, but picks out the fielder at deep midwicket and Saha takes a brilliant catch above his head and Katich is dejected.
plays to short fine leg.
shuffles across the stumps and drives down the ground to long off.
full delivery outside the off stump, driven down the ground to long off.
plays it softly to the vacant midwicket and quickly goes back for the second run, good running.
pushes to cover for a single.
well played, shuffles across the stumps and helps it on its way past the short fine leg to the fence.
good ball, inside edges on to the pads.
short delivery and Jayawardene looking for the upper cut, misses it and through to van Wyk.
shuffles across and plays to third man, Ishant Sharma does well.
cuts in the air over point to the deep for couple of runs.
short ball and Jayawardene opens the face off the bat and plays to wide third man for a single.
slower delivery and Katich plays with an angled bat behind point to pick up a single.
full delivery hit in the air just over Ganguly at mid-off for a boundary.
poor delivery from Shukla and Jayawardene just had to tickle it around and he does well to pick up a boundary to fine leg.
inside edges on the track.
cut hard to the sweeper.
plays it behind point.
width outside the off stump, cut hard to point.
short down the leg side, signalled a wide.
shuffles across and up on his toes and works to the onside for a single.
short ball and Jayawardene gets on top off it and cuts well to the point boundary.
off the pad to the onside.
fuller delivery pushed to mid-on for a tight single as Ganguly's throw comes in to the bowlers end, strikes Jayawardene as he reaches the crease.
looking to run it down was Jayawardene, falls short of Gayle at slip.
outside edge down to third man as Katich was looking to drive through the off side.
good length delivery and Sohel looking for more big hits, miscues it high in the air to mid-on, Ganguly running in takes a wonderful catch.
cuts and misses outside the off stump.
played behind point for a single.
hit hard along the ground to extra cover, good fielding.
good shot, picks up the short ball and pulls well high and over the square leg fence for maximum.
dropped again, tossed up delivery and Sohel miscues it high in the air to long on and Saha did well to get to the ball, but drops it.
looking to lap it around, miscues it to short fine leg.
cut away down to third man, poor throw and backing up, gives away an extra run and McCullum is furious.
wonderful timing, full delivery and in the slot for Katich, who hits it high and over the long on fence and into the stands for maximum.
pushes to mid-on for a single.
another maximum, it was short and wide, Sohal cuts hard in the air behind point and all the way over the fence.
lovely strike from Sohal, makes room and launches into the delivery and hits it high and over the extra cover fence for maximum.
shuffles across and works to square leg for a single.
outside edge and down to third man.
dropped, shuffles across his stumps and looks to flick it through the onside, gets a leading edge high in the air behind the wicket and Gayle calls for the catch and drops it.
good ball angled across, Katich shuffles across and misses the ball.
good shot from Katich, picks it up and lofts it over mid-on and to the fence, good timing.
moves back and across and defends to cover.
shuffles across and looks to work it through the onside, misses it and takes it on the pad.
short outside the off stump, Sohel slashes and misses, through to van Wyk.
short delivery and Katich moves across his stumps and works it square of the wicket on the onside.
plays with an angled bat square of the wicket on the off side.
down the leg side, signalled a wide.
dropped, cut hard in the air to the point fielder, Saha. Two drops in two balls.
dropped, short ball and Sohel looking to pull, gets it high on the bat and the ball just evades the hands of Dinda on his follow-through.
lovely delivery in the corridor outside the off stump, Sohel looking to run it down, gets beaten.
width outside the off stump and Sohel goes after it and gets beaten, signalled a wide.
good ball comes back into Sohel, who plays to point for a tight single.
short ball and Sangakkara looking to pull, gets a top-edge, which goes high in the air and van Wyk goes after it and judges it well to take a wonderful catch. Kings XI lose their first wicket.
gets behind the delivery and defends to the off side.
loud shout for an lbw turned down as there was an inside edge.
good ball back of a length and Sohel gets an inside edge onto his pads.
fuller delivery outside the off stump, pushed to mid-off and McCullum quickly to his left and does well save runs.
